messages:
mia: Quick UX ping 1: regen diffs screen. current pattern has an 'Approve' button on every row. with big runs that feels heavy. thinking: collapse per-row primary and expose a single top-level 'Approve selected' CTA + lightweight per-row checkbox/tick.
osh: I like that. top-level CTA should stay disabled when nothing selected. also show clear selected count (e.g., '3 selected') so keyboard users know state.
lisa: Accessibility: if we remove row-level primary, make sure selection is keyboard reachable and that the toolbar comes right after the list in DOM order so tabbing is intuitive. add an aria-live region for selection changes: "3 of 12 selected" (polite).
devon: Copy proposal for confirm: title "Approve 3 outputs" body "This will accept 3 outputs for this eval run. You can undo this action from the toast within 15s or revert individual outputs in the run history." primary button: "Approve 3 outputs" secondary: "Cancel".
mia: UX detail: replace full modal for small bulk ops (<5) with inline confirm sheet to reduce flow friction; still show modal for >20. Thoughts?
osh: fine but ensure focus is trapped in modal variant and inline sheet has clear keyboard controls. also inline confirm should still be accessible (role=dialog maybe).
lisa: microcopy tweak for scorecards: use "Satisfies threshold" / "Review needed" instead of Pass/Fail. more neutral.
devon: Performance note: when switching to toolbar approve, guard against accidental double submits. debounce + disable after click for 700ms and show spinner in CTA.
mia: design-bot color check: primary CTA #1565d8 fails AA small text at current weight (4.0:1). suggestions: darken to #0c4aa1 or bump font-weight.
devon: prefer darker color to avoid changing type scale. also add visible focus outline (2px) that is non-color dependent.
osh: accessibility: variant pill idea again — show a tiny variant pill on each row (abbr model name). keyboard focus should expose full model name via tooltip (aria-describedby). keep it subtle.
lisa: also add a small keyboard shortcut: Shift+A to approve selected (announce via SR: "Approve shortcut activated" and open confirm). Doc in keyboard shortcuts modal.
mia: undo UX: toast "3 outputs approved  Undo" with role=alert and Undo focusable. toast lives for 15s. log action id for audit.
devon: engineering ask: we need a server-side id for bulk action so undo can map to the set. will add in API design.
design-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2024-11-12 09:30am PT. Checklist: toolbar placement, inline confirm vs modal rules, aria-live phrasing, contrast token updates, undo TTL.
mia: I'll upload annotated mocks (compact view + expanded context examples) after lunch and add a small spec for keyboard flow. thanks team :thumbsup:
